theirReference: Cristian invited me to stay at his home in Bogotá, which worked out great because I didn’t have anywhere to sleep yet. As Cristian and his girlfriend Alo happened to be in La Candelaria already, we met up there and they showed me around a bit, and made me taste my first Cholao! In the evening Alo made some great quesadillas for us all and they showed me my private room with a great view over the city (I figured there was no need anymore to go to Monserrate 😜)! They showed me how to make arepas for breakfast and we talked a lot about travel stories and life in Colombia. I only stayed for one night but next time I’ll make sure to cook some traditional Dutch food for you! Thank you for your friendliness and for keeping up with my still-in-progress Spanish!
